triggerReasons.message: Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The section 1.1 envelope schema validates every field at schema time: matcher ids unique, kind limited to literal-line and class with no pattern language, the matcher array bounded at one to maxMatchers, a class matcher value naming a registered matcherClassRegistry entry case-sensitively, literal values trimmed within one to maxMatcherLen BYTES, closed stream and polarity enums, at least one present-in-red matcher, greenExempt only on present-in-red, the decidable timeout-is-failure with script-exit incompatibility rejected up front, and targetArtifactRef path syntax rejected for absolute, empty, dot, dot-dot and backslash segments.

The three minimum-specificity rules hold under the frozen default policy: degenerate literals are rejected by forbiddenCatchAlls membership, rule 2 is a length AND entropy CONJUNCTION proven by a differential table that separates AND from OR, a class matcher can never be the sole present-in-red evidence, and entropyBits is byteLength times empirical per-byte Shannon entropy - total bits, proven by a differential table that separates it from a per-symbol implementation.

assertionDigest is CANON over the assertion subobject including policyDigest and excluding assertionDigest itself, asserted in both directions; and the assertion is validated against the committed target binding with targetBindingDigest recomputed, returning the section 1.6 tags correctly discriminated so R1-2 (minimum specificity) and R1-3 (matcher and path bounds) are never collapsed.

The read-only red_evidence_envelope_check command lands following the existing read-only checker house pattern, changes no gate verdict, is registered with its smoke in lattice.config.json validate.commands, and reports on an admissible envelope the computed assertionDigest, the matched binding reference and the resolved policyDigest.

note: W2d envelope validation: 4 acceptance bindings cover all 16 checklist items; convergence anchors are the two differential tables (AND-vs-OR, total-bits-vs-per-symbol), the two-direction assertionDigest proof, and the full R1-x tag discrimination including the R1-3 count and registry bounds.
